target: Implement the orchestrator TUI under src/dopemux/tui/** and src/dopemux/orchestrator/ui/** with the eight read-only panels declared in DASHBOARD_PANELS
invariants: TUI panels remain read-only by default; no panel performs a workflow mutation directly
Every action button surfaces its tier + approval need; T4+ requires the existing approval phrase + explicit operator confirmation
Partial failures (PARTIAL receipts) are surfaced visibly in the relevant panel, not hidden
Framework choice is fixed before implementation; Textual is the default unless evidence rejects it

No new MCP write surfaces are added; the TUI only consumes the read/preview-only surfaces from TP-DMX-ORCH-005 and the live writers from TP-DMX-ORCH-009-LIVE/012-LIVE/013-LIVE through their existing approval gates
Snapshot tests cover every panel and are deterministic across CI environments

commit.message: feat(orchestrator): implement read-only TUI dashboard panels

pr.title: feat(orchestrator): implement read-only TUI dashboard panels
pr.body: Implements the actual TUI declared by DASHBOARD_PANELS in operator_workflows.py. Adds src/dopemux/tui/** (Textual app + 8 widgets) and src/dopemux/orchestrator/ui/** (data sources + snapshot helpers). All panels are read-only by default; action buttons display tier + approval requirement but never perform a write directly — they invoke the existing approval-gated CLI commands.

steps.task: Confirm the TUI framework choice. Default: Textual (already supported in dopemux-mvp's environment). Document the decision in docs/03-reference/orchestrator-integration/ui/_index.md with rationale and dependency footprint.
validation: Decision doc cites Textual as chosen (or records an explicit alternative with evidence).
Required pyproject.toml extras are listed in the doc and added (if not already).

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/orchestrator/ui/data_sources.py with a deterministic adapter for every panel: today (build_dashboard_snapshot), authority (load_approval_policy + classify_capability), packets (validate_packet_file matrix), proof (validate_proof_file matrix), risks (TX/TU/T6 from policy), pr_queue (build_pr_queue), context (context_status), do_not_touch (refusal-matrix snapshot).
validation: Every adapter is pure-read; no module-level side effects.
Adapters return shapes that match the existing operator_workflows helpers; no new helpers added in this packet.

steps.task: Implement one widget per panel under src/dopemux/tui/widgets/. Each widget consumes its data-source adapter and renders top-3 ADHD-friendly summaries with more_count + next_token where results are truncated.
validation: Widget tests assert deterministic rendering on representative fixtures.
Each widget displays tier + approval needs for any action it surfaces.

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/tui/app.py: the Textual App that mounts the 8 widgets in a layout matching DASHBOARD_PANELS order. Add a `dopemux orchestrator tui` CLI command that launches the app.
validation: App boots and renders without exceptions on an in-process headless run.
CLI test asserts the command exits cleanly with --once (snapshot-and-exit) mode.

steps.task: Add tests/snapshots/tui/ snapshots for every widget across empty / partial / full / error data states.
validation: Snapshots are deterministic on Linux + macOS CI.
Snapshot diffs include the panel name and the data state for easy review.

steps.task: Emit proof bundle at proof/dmx-orch-integration/TP-DMX-ORCH-015-TUI/PROOF.json with the full validations array, codereview/precommit status, snapshot-coverage matrix, not_run (live integration TUI session), residual_risks, and rollback_plan.
validation: Proof status is READY_FOR_REVIEW only after every panel's snapshot matrix is green.
